source: Chamonix Grands Montets piste map 2026-27 (skimap.org map 46148, the resort's PDF): run labels are real text printed in the run's colour; matched to map runs by script, the rest read by eye
names_note: Map label 'Bas Bochard' = Bochard Bas (the upper part is labelled Bochard), 'Variante de l'hôtel' = Variante Hotel, 'Tabé' = Tabe. The map's Pylônes under La Herse is OpenStreetMap's Pylônes Haut and Pylônes Bas. Croix de Lognan is green on the map (beginner area inset); OpenStreetMap had blue.
